head_commit.message:
build(lint): bump golangci-lint to v2.15.0 and fix what it now reports

The release updates errcheck (1.20 to 1.30) and gocognit (1.2.1 to 1.3.0).
errcheck now reports the receives from an error channel whose value is dropped
on purpose, in three places: waiting for the attach copy to end after the
context is done, draining the container wait channel of a failed hook, and
waiting for Up to return in a test. Say why on each, rather than handling an
error nobody can act on. gocognit's new count is handled by the previous
commit.

Signed-off-by: Nicolas De Loof <nicolas.deloof@gmail.com>
